summary: Second-Stage Responsive Layout Correction across Ellic OS. Structurally redesigned Dashboard Hero Section into a flexible responsive layout with whitespace-nowrap badges, full-width heading, and balanced wrapping action buttons. Architected the desktop Sidebar into 3 distinct, non-overlapping regions (Region 1: fixed branding & store selector, Region 2: independently scrollable navigation with visible thin scrollbar, Region 3: bottom-pinned utility panels). Stabilized Navbar controls and validated across all zoom levels (80%–150%).
